## The claim

P4-7 (claude-code mode only): the LLM-written interpretation section of every per-model report cites its numbers — each sentence ends in a row id from the report's own sections 2-5 — so the uncited-sentence rate stays at or under 10 %, and no gene or disease the rows never named appears in the prose.

**Prediction if true.** Run mva-zoo narrate in mode claude-code over all four MVP lanes (alphamissense, esm1b, revel, spliceai). For each lane, mva.zoo.narrate_check reports uncited_sentences / sentences <= 0.10 and new_names == (), and the reply is at most 200 words. Scope: claude-code only; the nebius mode is built and fake-transport tested but not run, because NEBIUS_API_KEY is absent on this machine.

**What would refute it.** Any of the four lanes returns an interpretation whose uncited-sentence rate exceeds 10 %, or whose prose names a gene or disease that appears in none of the citable rows. Either observation is recorded per lane, not averaged away.
